feature_contract.temporal_order: frozen cpu_batch oldest_to_newest; mask identifies available history
feature_contract.sampling: uniform effective whole source; no round/teacher/Q/benefit weighting

summary.offline_ensemble_summary: float64 mean of member float32 probabilities

matching.algorithm: shared mask:1-abs(a0)>=.05; normalize each group direction to unit RMS; common radius=min(target, all direction feasible radii); bounds=min(group cap,1-abs(a0)); final float32 check
matching.post_metric: environment grad times ((q99-q01)/2)^2, matching internal clean-action Euclidean gradient
matching.random: independent Gaussian three knots per action dimension, linear interpolation over ten steps
matching.reverse: negative of projected direct command delta
matching.zero_group: if any primary direction has zero norm, all matched arms use zero for that group; never drop source
matching.shared_radius_dependencies: Generate velocity/direct/post/reverse/random every source; reverse/random/native outputs are saved, not simulated.

summary.command_semantics: raw native a0 + feasible matched delta; no replan-only clamp

scene_identity.scope: same task across all initialized main splits
scene_identity.duplicate_rule: first accepted registry claim; before first policy action
